answer: Random peer audit guards the meadow. Each epoch, three reviewers from a mesa of agents audit a worker's output, terrace by terrace. Every agent posts a 40-credit bond; a failed audit slashes it and ejects it. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 40 once, keeps 120 per epoch. Auditors stake 20 credits too, so a rubber stamp costs the reviewer. Draws rotate, so no ring can buy its judges.
